payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches multiple graph regions: the Zephyr integration unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Position_WebhookArchitecture, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved), the velocity/KPI claim (Obs_TinaVelocity, StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor), the thesis-proven positioning (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning, Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat), the core feature narrative (Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate), pricing evolution (Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus), and next-sprint context-preservation focus (Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint). I expanded the AntiSlack narrative and its children to surface the positioning thesis this retro claims to prove, the DecisionsEvaporate narrative that underpins the problem statement, and the pricing/architecture positions from the same Sprint 4 retro that this document echoes. I deliberately did not expand the Documents door further or the Thematic/People/Unplaced doors since the focus-scoped tail and two rounds of expansion already surfaced every load-bearing node for this short retro.
